High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Compass Service API.

Provides compass heading information from magnetometer and accelerometer.

Imports

../../ffi

Procs

proc peek(data: ptr CompassHeadingData): bool {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Get the current compass heading. Returns true on success, false on error. Equivalent to C function compass_service_peek(data). 
proc setHeadingFilter(filter: CompassHeading) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Set the compass heading filter in degrees (0-360). Smaller values = more updates but less stable. Equivalent to C function compass_service_set_heading_filter(filter). 
proc subscribe(handler: CompassHeadingHandler) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [],
    forbids: [].}
Subscribe to compass heading updates. Equivalent to C function compass_service_subscribe(handler). 
proc unsubscribe() {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Unsubscribe from compass heading updates. Equivalent to C function compass_service_unsubscribe().
